title: Green Curry with Chicken
description: Green curry paste fried in coconut cream until the oil separates out — the step that actually builds flavor — then simmered with chicken, Thai eggplant, and basil.

image.alt: Thai green curry with chicken and vegetables in a dark bowl on a wooden table

ingredients: 150g Thai eggplant, quartered (or 1 regular eggplant, cubed)
steps: Spoon the thick cream from the top of the unshaken coconut milk into a wok or deep pan over medium heat.
Fry the curry paste in the coconut cream for 3–4 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant and the oil begins to separate at the edges.
Add the chicken and cook 3–4 minutes, turning to coat in the paste.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and the stock. Add the eggplant and lime leaves, and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the bell pepper, fish sauce, and palm sugar. Simmer 5–8 minutes more until the chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Stir in the Thai basil off the heat until just wilted. Garnish with sliced chilies and serve over jasmine rice.
note: Don't shake the coconut milk can — separating the cream is what lets you fry the paste properly.
